pillars.h: Everything for a celebration to remember.
pillars.tldr: Looking for wonderful people with great personalities, quickly and easily? FireFlair Packages bring the people, the equipment and the shopping list for your celebration. Choose the package that suits you, from a classic bartender to a hands-on masterclass, and every booking comes with the FireFlair Booking Guarantee: confirmed, or refunded in full.

seo.title: FireFlair Packages for Your Party | FF Party
seo.description: Choose a FireFlair Package for your celebration, from a classic bartender to a hands-on masterclass, and book with the FireFlair Booking Guarantee.

card.d: From a classic bartender to a hands-on masterclass.

sections.h: Find the package that suits your celebration
p: Each FireFlair Package brings the people, the shopping list and the equipment. Choose the one that suits your celebration.
Already have your drinks? The Cocktail Package brings a bartender with the equipment, a cocktail menu and a shopping list.
Planning a hen party or birthday to remember? The Masterclass Package is the Open Bar Masterclass: shake, stir and create your own recipes.

seo.title: Find the package that suits your celebration | FF Party
seo.description: From a classic bartender to a hands-on masterclass.

sections.h: Book with the FireFlair Booking Guarantee
p: Book with nothing to lose. Your booking is confirmed, or you are refunded in full.
Every FireFlair Package follows the same four steps, so you always know where you are: choose your package, choose your people, choose your add-ons, and your booking is secured.
Every booking comes with an event brief and an invoice with clear terms, so everyone knows what to expect.

seo.title: Book with the FireFlair Booking Guarantee | FF Party

sections.h: Choose the professional you would love behind your bar
p: Browse bartenders and choose the person you would love behind your bar.
Every professional has a Profile Card with their style, their experience and reviews from hosts, so you know who you are choosing.
Your first choice is asked first, so your favourite person gets the first chance to say yes.

seo.title: Choose the professional you would love behind your bar | FF Party

pillars.h: Meet the people who make it happen.
pillars.tldr: Looking for a bartender whose style suits your celebration? Browse professionals with real reviews from hosts, and look for the Verified by FireFlair badges and the people who vouch for each one. Prefer a company that brings the bar? Browse bar companies and their teams.

seo.title: Bartenders and Bar Companies for Your Party | FF Party
seo.description: Browse bartenders with real reviews from hosts, Verified by FireFlair badges and bar companies with their own teams.

card.d: Hosts have booked them and said so.

sections.h: Meet the bartenders hosts have booked
p: Featured professionals, with their reviews and the people who vouch for them.
Look for the Verified by FireFlair badges. Bronze, Silver and Gold are set by FireFlair and show on every profile.
The people they work with show on their profile too, so you can see who vouches for them.

seo.title: Meet the bartenders hosts have booked | FF Party
seo.description: Hosts have booked them and said so.

card.d: From hosts who have booked them.

sections.h: Read what hosts say about a night with them
p: Reviews are written by hosts who have booked the same people, so you can read what a night with them was really like.
Every review comes from a real event and is left by the person who booked.
Every review shows on their profile. After your party, you review your team in a tap.

seo.title: Read what hosts say about a night with them | FF Party
seo.description: From hosts who have booked them.

sections.h: Book a bar company and choose from its team
p: Bar companies bring their own bar and team. Browse them, read their reviews and book for your event.
Book a company, then choose your bartenders from its team.
Every FF company has a Company Card that shows who they are, what they do and who is on the team.

seo.title: Book a bar company and choose from its team | FF Party

Your first choice is asked first, so your favourite person gets the first chance to say yes.

Stag dos, garden parties, anniversaries, Christmas parties and New Year's Eve are all covered too.
Whatever you are celebrating, the right packages appear after a few simple details.

p: Choose your package, choose your people, choose your add-ons, and your booking is secured.
Your request reaches each professional on WhatsApp, so you hear back quickly.
When everything is confirmed, you see Your booking is secured, with an event brief and an invoice that set out the terms clearly.

pillars.tldr: Save your tastes once and every booking begins with them in place: your drinks, your style and your favourite people. Keep your favourite bartenders, book your best nights again and share your VIP Host Card with the people you hire.

Your Party is your own space on FireFlair, so every future celebration starts exactly how you like it.
The people you hire see your VIP Host Card before the day.
